column1: # Schema fingerprint allowlist — differences that are EXPECTED between a
# reference and a candidate, each with a written reason.
# Format: one entry per line, 4 TAB-separated fields:
#   - section must be "app" or "platform" ("info" never fails, so it is never
#   - object_key must match EXACTLY. There are no wildcards and no
#     category-wide entries — every tolerated difference is named.
#   - Entries that matched nothing in a comparison are reported as stale so
# Intentionally EMPTY. No entry is added on speculation: the first real
# comparison against a freshly built environment (baseline phase) will show
# which platform-managed objects genuinely differ (e.g. platform extension
# versions on a newer Supabase project), and each one is added here, with
# its reason, only after it has been observed and reviewed.

column4: Supabase-managed; version differs on newer projects (observed YYYY-MM-DD)
